entry.gap: As amended by ADD-03 5.2, the Bid Bond runs two hundred and ten (210) days from the Proposal Due Date and must be extended only when Proposal validity (still 150 days under VOL-I 7.1) is extended, but VOL-I 12.2 lets the Authority call it if Financial Close is missed by the long-stop date, counted from the Preferred Bidder Notification (270 days). No clause requires the bond to cover that period, and 'long-stop date' is not defined. Whether the 210-day period reaches the long-stop date depends on when the Preferred Bidder Notification is given; no date is computed here.
entry.already_settled: ADD-02 Q13 settles that the 12.2 periods (Commercial Close 120 days, Financial Close 270 days from the Preferred Bidder Notification) are unchanged; ADD-02 Q8 and ADD-01 Q3 settle the bond amount basis and issuer; ADD-03 5.1 and 5.2 restate the bond amount and validity period and confirm the Proposal validity period in Clause 7.1 is unchanged. None of these is re-asked.
entry.practical_impact: Determines the expiry date and extension commitment the issuing bank must give, and its cost, and the Preferred Bidder's exposure to a call at Financial Close; a fixed-expiry bank instrument must be drafted to match.
entry.proposed_question: Volume I, Clause 6.3, page 3 (as amended by Addendum No. 3 Clause 5.2), and Clause 12.2, page 6: Clause 6.3 requires the Bid Bond to remain valid for 210 days from the Proposal Due Date, extended where Proposal validity is extended, while Clause 12.2 entitles the Authority to call the Bid Bond if Financial Close is not achieved by the long-stop date, which may fall up to 270 days after the Preferred Bidder Notification. Will the Preferred Bidder be required to extend the Bid Bond so that it remains valid until Financial Close or the long-stop date and, if so, to what date?
entry.interim_handling: Arrange the bond to VOL-I 6.3-6.4 as amended by ADD-03 5.1 and 5.2, with an expiry no earlier than the later counting reading of the program's computed 210-day validity date (counted from the Proposal Due Date as amended by ADD-03 2.1; the date previously carried here was counted from the superseded 180-day period and is withdrawn from this entry, not retyped), and obtain the bank's indicative agreement to extend it through a Financial Close long-stop; carry that extension cost in the bid budget without assuming the Authority's answer.
